besluite.rede: The ellipsis 'en die hoofman heel laaste' is natural, compact Afrikaans that a Grade 4 reader completes easily; the proposal is a lateral move that adds a third 'gepraat' in two sentences.

besluite.fout: The Afrikaans book title is capitalised on every main word, against the AWS rule that capitalises only the first word, and it is not marked off from the sentence.
besluite.rede: The published Afrikaans title is 'Lang pad na vryheid', and the quotation marks keep the lower-cased title readable as a title inside the sentence without changing what it says.

besluite.fout: The glossary definition says 'almal wat hier woon' where the study text quotes the Charter twice as 'almal wat daarin woon'.
besluite.rede: The inconsistency is real, but this rewords a [begrip] definition beyond a spelling or grammar error, so the writer must decide it for every lesson that carries the term.
